create_ConditionalDetrConfig: create a ConditionalDetrConfig instance to configure a Conditional DETR model with custom hyperparameters
initialize_ConditionalDetrConfig: initialize a ConditionalDetrConfig with default settings for the microsoft/conditional-detr-resnet-50 checkpoint
configure_ConditionalDetr_model: configure a Conditional DETR encoder-decoder model with specified encoder and decoder layer counts
set_ConditionalDetr_backbone: set a resnet50 timm backbone configuration for ConditionalDetrConfig with custom output indices
customize_ConditionalDetr_loss: customize ConditionalDetrConfig loss coefficients including class, bbox, giou, and focal alpha parameters
